summary.title: Celia, Robotics, and Space
summary.description: Celia and a man clash over her robotics and his dream of space, while memories and old hurt surface. In a futuristic city threatened by giant machines, the pair confront the past as a memory override progresses and their relationship begins to change.

keyMoments.title: A Confession About Robot Glasses
keyMoments.description: A friend challenges someone about fearing a robot hand, prompting an admission of fear and a nightmare about giant robotic glasses.

keyMoments.title: Choosing Space Over Robotics
keyMoments.description: One person says they must follow their passion for space while acknowledging Celia's interest in robotics.

keyMoments.title: A Heartbreak Left On Earth
keyMoments.description: An argument about a robot hand turns into a confrontation over a broken heart and being left behind on Earth.

keyMoments.title: Abort The Memory Override
keyMoments.description: A memory override reaches 90 percent as the crew calls for an abort, then the characters consider changing with the world.
